title: What a wonderful way to...
text: What a wonderful way to see the city. Our guide Rigo was amazing. Great set up with the choice of regular or e-bikes which were in great shape.
author: Amy_B

title: Outstanding guide for a wonderful tour.
text: Outstanding trip. A great way to see the key sites and learn a lot of history and interesting facts. Rigo was excellent. I highly recommend this tour.
author: Jim_H

title: Nice experience!
text: Very good tour, entertaining and dynamic. Garmin our very friendly guide, allowed us to meet and fall in love with the city more. Thank you so much!
author: Paola_S

title: Nice relaxing way to see the city
text: This is an easy and safe route around Seville. Most of the trip is in the bike lane or through a park. The e-bike is smooth and can do most of the work if you can pedal lightly.
author: steven_g

title: Top guide
text:
Rigo our guide was the best! 
Gave us quite an insight into the city, the people, the history etc. with quite some passion and fun.
author: Siddharth_M

title: Fantastic bike your. Tour...
text: Fantastic bike your. Tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable of local history. Nice to have some in depth context of what you are viewing.
author: James_C
